story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯称缺乏资金升级2026赛车，难追迈凯伦开发步伐
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯表示因资金不足，无法通过紧急升级回应迈凯伦的强势复苏，难以跟上对手的开发速度。迈凯伦在匈牙利和荷兰大奖赛分两阶段引入的升级效果显著，兰多·诺里斯在荷兰大奖赛凭借节奏和更好的轮胎管理超越起步领先安东内利，取得赛季两连胜。
story.originalTitle: Mercedes' extraordinary reason for not upgrading its F1 car
story.summaryEn: Mercedes says it cannot respond to McLaren's F1 resurgence with an urgent upgrade because it hasn't got the money for extra developments. McLaren's two-stage upgrade across the Hungarian and Dutch Grands Prix proved decisive, as Lando Norris's pace and superior tyre management allowed him to overhaul early leader Kimi Antonelli and claim his second consecutive victory.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯表示，无法通过紧急升级来应对迈凯伦在F1中的强势复苏，因为他们没有“钱”在赛车上投入额外的研发。
上周日的荷兰大奖赛中，兰多·诺里斯为迈凯伦取得了本赛季连续第二场胜利，他的速度和更出色的轮胎管理让他得以超越比赛早期的领先者基米·安东内利。
迈凯伦在匈牙利和荷兰两站大奖赛分两阶段实施的重大升级所带来的跨越式进步令梅赛德斯感到意外，并让积分榜领跑者安东内利确信自己的车队已不再拥有最快的赛车。
在这种情况下，车队通常会加快升级的步伐，以帮助梅赛德斯重返领先位置。
然而，车队领队托托·沃尔夫表示，他的车队无法偏离自赛季开始以来所采用的分散部署研发的策略——因为在成本上限的限制下，他们没有余力引入太多升级。
“我们没有钱把研发成果装到赛车上，”他说。
“我以前就说过，我们正努力在整个赛季中均匀分配这些升级，根据我们的计算来判断何时能带来最大的升级，并优化锦标赛积分。我们做不到的事情就是做不到。”
自年初以来，梅赛德斯在研发支出方面一直比竞争对手保守得多。
自加拿大大奖赛以来，该车就没有进行过重大升级，并且在荷兰大奖赛上选择不加入其最接近的竞争对手的行列，不带来任何重要的新部件。
根据国际汽联（FIA）公布的2026年已申报升级项目的官方数据，就引进的升级数量而言，梅赛德斯远远落后。
法拉利引入了40个新部件，红牛和迈凯伦为38个，而梅赛德斯仅引入了24个。
然而，这些基本数字并不能完全反映在研发上花费了多少，因为例如一个新的底板，其成本要远高于一个后视镜罩。
一项加权分析对每个新部件给出成本评级，结果显示红牛在四大领先车队中位居榜首，略高于迈凯伦，法拉利第三，梅赛德斯则落后不少。
目前尚不清楚，为什么梅赛德斯在升级方面如此保守，却没有像其他车队那样拥有额外的研发支出空间。
一种猜测是，梅赛德斯较早地将更多资源投入2026年项目，希望先在积分榜上建立起足够大的优势，从而后期无需在研发上花费太多，同时让对手打消把钱浪费在一场他们无法夺冠的争斗中的念头。
但任何想凭借自身速度扩大优势、让对手无法染指总冠军的希望，都被赛季初的可靠性问题所打断，这些问题让法拉利、以及现在的迈凯伦一直保持在前列。
当The 比赛问及早期的开支是否解释了为什么梅赛德斯似乎不像带来更多升级的其他车队那样具备同等能力时，沃尔夫并不认同这种说法。
“我们在最初的研发阶段是否花费太多？我不这么认为，”他说。
“我只是觉得我们是一个拥有一定规模和基础设施的组织。而且，你知道，在这方面，我们当时有一辆非常快的车。
“由于可靠性问题，我们损失了大约50到100分，否则我们本可以比今天拥有更大的领先优势。
“除此之外，我们只是在继续执行原本的计划，以及财务现实对我们意味着什么。”
梅赛德斯副领队Bradley Lord在夏休期前表示，车队有大量研发潜力正在系统中推进——问题只是这些部件何时被带到赛道上。
“目前有相当可观的性能提升正在生产体系中推进，它们将从夏休结束后的比赛开始陆续应用到赛车上。”
迈凯伦并不认为梅赛德斯在成本上限方面处于被动，并认为对方在实际引进升级件方面拥有比其所暗示的更多自由度。
随着额外成本上限豁免（两笔各300万美元）被加入规则以帮助车队适应2027年及以后的新动力单元规则，这一点尤其正确。
当The 比赛问及沃尔夫关于车队在支出上处于被动局面的言论时，迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉表示：“我愿意相信你，但实际上我并不相信。我不相信，因为得益于2027年动力单元规则，所有车队在成本上限申报中都将获得一笔额外额度。”
“我确信梅赛德斯在看到对手们有点提升水平之后，现在一定会兑现他们的研发成果。可以肯定的是，这正在实际发生。”
“我确信他们在风洞里的赛车要比现在赛道上的那辆快不少，他们会希望把其中一些潜力转化为应用到真实赛车上的升级。我非常肯定他们会有升级。当然，如果没有那会很好，但我甚至不愿意去想那种情况。”
沃尔夫认为，最终梅赛德斯的成本上限策略只能通过整个赛季来评判——因为可能存在其他车队在赛季后期不得不削减开支，而他的车队还有更多余量的情况。
“你会看到，到了赛季末，他们是否还能像现在这样往赛车上部署那么多部件，”他说。
“也许有人的策略不同，在年初和年中投入更多，而到赛季末投入较少。”
今年早些时候，沃尔夫曾暗示梅赛德斯无法理解马拉内罗车队（法拉利）怎么能为SF-26带来这么多激进的升级，这惹恼了法拉利。
沃尔夫的立场引发了法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔（Fred Vasseur）的尖锐回应。
"我觉得托托和梅赛德斯说这话相当讽刺," 他说。"但红牛在研发或者梅赛德斯在研发的时候，他们就是天才。轮到我们研发的时候，我们就是在作弊。"
让梅赛德斯在选择何时投入升级的问题上更加复杂的是，安东内利将在他的主场意大利大奖赛接受引擎处罚——因此他在那里争夺胜利的机会将受到阻碍。
沃尔夫补充道："从理论上讲，我们的计算表明那是搭载新引擎的最佳赛道。"
“显然，算法不会把国籍考虑在内。但我们来这里是为了争夺冠军，而不是为了获得最多的公关曝光。所以，是的，这就是我们要做的。至于George，如果我们决定采取这个方案，相关的讨论还在进行中。”
detailEn: Mercedes says it can't respond to McLaren’s Formula 1 resurgence with an urgent upgrade because it hasn’t “got the money” to put extra developments on its car.

Lando Norris delivered his second consecutive victory of the season for McLaren in the Dutch Grand Prix on Sunday as his pace and better tyre management allowed him to overhaul early race leader Kimi Antonelli.

The major step that a two-stage upgrade from McLaren over the Hungarian and Dutch Grands Prix unleashed has caught Mercedes by surprise – and left championship leader Antonelli convinced his squad no longer has the fastest car.
Such a scenario would typically trigger a move to fast-track upgrades to help get Mercedes back to the front.

However, team boss Toto Wolff has suggested that his outfit cannot divert from the strategy it has employed since the start of the campaign to spread out its developments – as it does not have the leeway under the cost cap to bring many changes through.
“We haven't got the money to put developments on the car,” he said.

“I said it before, we are trying to evenly split that through the season, based on our calculations of when we can bring the biggest updates and optimising the championship points. We just can't do what we can't do.”
Mercedes has been much less aggressive than its rivals since the start of the year with its development spending.
It has not had a major upgrade since the Canadian Grand Prix and elected against joining its closest rivals in bringing any major new parts to the Dutch Grand Prix.
Based on the official FIA figures for declared upgrades over 2026, Mercedes is well behind when it comes to the number it has brought.
Ferrari has introduced 40 new components, Red Bull and McLaren 38, while Mercedes has introduced just 24.
However, those basic numbers do not tell the full story of how much spending has been done on development, as a new floor, for example, costs a lot more than a mirror shroud.
A weighted analysis giving a cost grade for each new component puts Red Bull at the top of the leading four teams, just ahead of McLaren, with Ferrari third and Mercedes quite a bit adrift.
It is not clear why, after being so conservative with its upgrades, Mercedes does not have the same headroom as other teams for extra development spending.

One theory could be that it invested more into the 2026 project early on in the hope of building up such an advantage in the championship that it did not need to spend much on development later on and rivals were put off wasting money on a title they could not win.
But any hopes of capitalising on its pace and putting the championship out of reach of its rivals were derailed by early-season reliability woes that have kept Ferrari, and now McLaren, in touch.
When asked by The Race about whether early spending explained why Mercedes did not appear to have the same capabilities as other teams who have brought more, Wolff was not convinced.
“Did we spend too much at the beginning in the initial development? I don't think so,” he said.
“I just think we're an organisation that has a certain size and infrastructure. And, you know, in that respect, we had a really quick car.
“We left between 50 and 100 points on the table with reliability issues and that would have given us a little bit more of a gap than we have today.
“Other than that, we're just continuing to execute what the plan was and what the financial realities mean for us.”

Speaking before the summer break, Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord said that the squad had plenty of development potential coming through the system – it was just a question of when items were brought to the track.
“There's a decent amount of performance working its way through the production machinery at the moment, that will start coming to the car from the races after shutdown.”
McLaren is not convinced that Mercedes is on the back foot when it comes to cost cap limits, and thinks it has more freedom to bring upgrades than it is suggesting.

This is especially true with an extra cost cap allowance, of two lots of $3 million, that has been added to the regulations aimed at helping teams adjust to the new power unit rules for 2027 and beyond.

Asked by The Race about Wolff’s remarks suggesting it was on the backfoot with spending, McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said: “I would like to believe you, but I actually don't believe you. I don't believe it, because thanks to the 2027 power unit regulations, all teams will have an allowance in their reporting for the cost-cap.
“I'm sure that Mercedes, having seen that the rivals are kind of elevating the game, I'm sure they will now cash in on their development. Surely, it's happening on the ground.

“I'm sure the car in the windtunnel is quite a bit faster than the car they have on track, and they will want to now convert some of this potential into upgrades that make it to the real car. I'm pretty sure that they will have upgrades. Obviously, it would be good if not, but I don't even want to think it.”

Wolff thinks that ultimately the Mercedes cost cap strategy can only be judged over the full season – as it could be that others may have to switch off spending later in the campaign while his outfit has some more headroom.
“You will see how towards the end of the season if they're going to be able to deploy as much stuff onto the car as they do now,” he said.
“Someone might have a different strategy in spending more at the beginning and in the middle of the year than towards the end.”
Earlier in the year, Wolff annoyed Ferrari by suggesting Mercedes could not understand how the Maranello squad had been able to be so aggressive with bringing upgrades to the SF-26.
Wolff’s stance triggered a pointed response from Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur.
"I found it quite ironic coming from Toto and Mercedes," he said. "But when Red Bull is developing or when Mercedes is developing, they are genius. When we are developing, we are cheating.”

Adding to Mercedes’ complications over the choice of timing of committing to bring an upgrade is that Antonelli will take an engine penalty at his home Italian Grand Prix – so his chances of fighting for the win there will be hampered.
Wolff added: “In theory, our calculations say that that's the best track to take it.

“Obviously, algorithms don't take the nationality into consideration. But we're here to fight for a championship and not get the most PR. So, yeah, that's what we're going to do. With George, the discussions are ongoing on if we were to take it.”

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.

relatedItems.titleZh: 马来西亚大奖赛回归在即，车手期待雪邦或将上演混乱激战
relatedItems.summaryZh: 阔别近十年后，F1将于2026年重返雪邦，替代被取消的巴林和沙特大奖赛，车手们对这条久未造访的赛道展开了各自的预测。
relatedItems.originalTitle: 'Chaotic racing'? - What F1 drivers expect from Malaysia return
relatedItems.summaryEn: Formula 1 will return to Sepang in 2026 after nearly a decade away, replacing the cancelled Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix, and drivers have been sharing their early predictions about the challenge ahead.
keyPointsZh: 大部分车手在阿塞拜疆-马来西亚-新加坡三连赛开始前已在模拟器上为雪邦做了准备
威廉姆斯的模拟数据显示，雪邦在2026年赛道中的能源管理需求约为中等水平，与加拿大和奥地利站相近
世界冠军兰多·诺里斯曾在2017年为迈凯伦车手阿隆索和范多恩担任模拟器支持工作
keyPointsEn: Most drivers had already completed simulator preparations for Sepang before the Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header began
Williams's data places Sepang around average in energy management demands for 2026 circuits, similar to Canada and Austria
World champion Lando Norris provided sim support for McLaren's race drivers Fernando Alonso and Stoffel Vandoorne the last time F1 raced there in 2017
